about: STARWAKE 0.4.0: the effects that exist, so the game only asks for what is there. The sound branch adds each name when its take lands in audio/sfx/<name>.{ogg,mp4}: powerups (pu-*), shared (any other always-loaded cue), galaxies (g2-*/g3-* effects a level lists in its sfx; one not listed is skipped, never fetched).
